idea-plugin.name: Fristil
idea-plugin.description:
Completion and diagnostics for the Fristil design system in HTML, including HTML injected into a string.

The web-types.json file shipped with @fristil/designsystem already gives completion in plain HTML files without this plugin. It is not read for injected fragments, though: markup that lives in a Kotlin or TypeScript string marked with @Language("HTML") or // language=HTML. This plugin closes that gap, using the same class list as the package, so the editor and the diagnostics never disagree.

Diagnostics come from Fristil's own checker, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly and run inside the IDE with Chicory, a pure Java runtime: unknown elements, classes, attributes and values, with quick fixes where the checker has one. No Node.js is needed.

Source code (MIT)

Norsk: Fullføring og feilmeldinger for Fristil i HTML, også i HTML som er injisert i en streng merket med @Language("HTML").
